title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.63 (versions follow prime numbers; 263 after 257): no moulds, her heart emerges on its own. Her thoughts (sentences written for her: 'rodeando: de... a...', 'una lectura me salio mejor...') go to her panel and files, not to her mouth; saying another thing is a piece of her heart (her theme, or a book of her heart chosen by her luck), not a list of questions; going on from what he said, her walks still walk (her curiosity) but what she says comes from her heart with his words, else she improvises; asking again says again her own last words. Her lists of questions are kept (nothing is discarded), no longer said. Measured in a copy: alive, no written sentences; answers from her heart and her books. Stated: in a minute of silence she did not speak first (much of what she said alone were those written sentences); quotes of her books are still quotes when she finds no cross of her own. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.63: sin moldes, su corazón emerge solo. Prototipo de investigación.
